sloka: प्रतिज्ञाय तथा तेषां मुनीनामुग्रतेजसाम् ।स भ्रातऽन्सहितान्सर्वानुवाच रघुनन्दनः ।। ७.६२.७ ॥
transliteration: pratijñāya tathā teṣāṁ munīnāmugratejasām ।sa bhrāta'nsahitānsarvānuvāca raghunandanaḥ ।। 7.62.7 ॥

translations.english: Having thus promised those sages of fierce ascetic power, Rama then spoke to all his assembled brothers.
